literal: Cold dew budding, distress having evening, intense grief budding, suffering to grow, comes.
translation: The evening, which arrives shedding cold dew and bringing distress, comes budding with intense grief to make my suffering grow.
modern: குளிர்ச்சியான பனித்துளிகளைச் சிந்தி, துன்பத்தைத் தரும் மாலைப் பொழுது, என் நெஞ்சில் வெறுப்பைத் தோற்றுவித்துத் துயரத்தை வளர்க்கும் வகையில் வருகிறது.
explanation: This couplet describes the painful arrival of evening for a heroine separated from her lover. The poet beautifully uses the word 'அரும்பி' (budding) twice to draw a parallel between nature and emotion. First, the evening arrives 'budding' with cold dew (பனி அரும்பி), which physically chills the environment and brings distress (பைதல்). Second, as this evening advances, it causes intense grief or resentment (துனி) to 'bud' (அரும்பி) within her heart, causing her overall suffering (துன்பம்) to grow even larger.
